# openrouter Provider

OpenRouter API: OpenAI-compatible API with additional OpenRouter features

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    openrouter = {
      source  = "OpenRouterTeam/openrouter"
      version = "0.0.15"
    }
  }
}

provider "openrouter" {
  server_url = "..." # Optional
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key as bearer token in Authorization header.
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1)
